examples.chinese: 甜的點心叫甜點。
examples.pinyin: Tián de diǎnxīn jiào tiándiǎn.
examples.english: Sweet snacks are called dessert.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

examples.chinese: 這些水果，有的不甜，我不想吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, yǒude bù tián, wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
examples.english: Some of this fruit are not sweet, I do not want to eat them.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: This kind of beverage tastes good.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào.
examples.english: They have various kinds of drink.

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

items.wordHook: 語言(language) + 交換(exchange) → 語言交換 is a language exchange.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

items.wordHook: 剛(just) + 才(just now) both point to the same recent moment, so 剛才 means "just now."

examples.chinese: 這個地方到處都有垃圾，又髒又臭，誰要住在這裡呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfāng dàochù dōu yǒu lājī, yòu zāng yòu chòu, shéi yào zhù zài zhèlǐ ne?
examples.english: This place has garbage everywhere; it's both dirty and smelly—who would want to live here?

examples.chinese: 陳小姐從小就愛史努比，所以臥房裡到處都是史努比的娃娃。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù ài Shǐnǔbǐ, suǒyǐ wòfáng lǐ dàochù dōu shì Shǐnǔbǐ de wáwa.
examples.english: Miss Chen has loved Snoopy since childhood, so there are Snoopy dolls everywhere in her bedroom.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo zuìjìn hěn déyì, dàochù gàosù línjū tā érzi kǎo shàng le quánguó zuì yǒumíng de dàxué.
examples.english: Uncle Wang has been very proud of himself recently, telling neighbors everywhere that his son has been admitted to the most famous university in the country.

examples.chinese: 自從去年伯母退休後，就帶著伯父到處去旅行了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng qùnián bómǔ tuìxiū hòu, jiù dàizhe bófù dàochù qù lǚxíng le.
examples.english: Ever since my aunt retired last year, she has been taking my uncle traveling everywhere.

examples.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
examples.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
examples.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

examples.chinese: 為了保住勞工的福利，她到處去演講。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhù láogōng de fúlì, tā dàochù qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to protect laborers' welfare, she went everywhere to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhòngdà jiérì, chéngshì lǐ jiù dàochù chōngmǎn le huānlè de qìfēn.
examples.english: Whenever a major festival arrives, the city is filled everywhere with a joyful atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夏天熱得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān rè de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: Taiwan's summers are incredibly hot!

examples.chinese: 那個照相機貴得不得了，我買不起。
examples.pinyin: Nàge zhàoxiàngjī guì de bùdéliǎo, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
examples.english: That camera is extremely expensive; I can't afford to buy it.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

examples.chinese: 黃小姐生日那天，男朋友送給她九百九十九朵玫瑰花，讓她感動得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě shēngrì nà tiān, nánpéngyǒu sòng gěi tā jiǔbǎi jiǔshí jiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, ràng tā gǎndòng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: On Miss Huang's birthday, her boyfriend gave her 999 roses, which moved her incredibly.

examples.chinese: 張經理不但常加班，還要做市場研究，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ bùdàn cháng jiābān, hái yào zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, měitiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Manager Zhang not only often works overtime but also has to do market research; every day he is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，差不多五度，冷得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, chàbuduō wǔ dù, lěng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low, about five degrees, and it was extremely cold.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān máng de bùdéliǎo, lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: He is incredibly busy today; he doesn't even have time for a single mouthful of water.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣覺得方靜文變了，可是靜文覺得自己沒變。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn juéde Fāng Jìngwén biàn le, kěshì Jìngwén juéde zìjǐ méi biàn.
examples.english: Chen Kexin feels that Fang Jingwen has changed, but Jingwen feels that she herself hasn't changed.

examples.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

examples.chinese: 以前沒什麼人喜歡露營，可是最近露營變成了一種流行的活動。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián méi shénme rén xǐhuān lùyíng, kěshì zuìjìn lùyíng biànchéngle yī zhǒng liúxíng de huódòng.
examples.english: Before, not many people liked camping, but recently camping has become a popular activity.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣變得很冷，所以我常常頭痛。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì biàn de hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng tóutòng.
examples.english: Recently the weather has become very cold, so I often have headaches.

examples.chinese: 隔壁的王媽媽化妝以後，變年輕了。
examples.pinyin: Gébì de Wáng māma huàzhuāng yǐhòu, biàn niánqīng le.
examples.english: After putting on makeup, Mrs. Wang next door became younger.

examples.chinese: 從下個月起，飛機票就變貴了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xià gè yuè qǐ, fēijī piào jiù biàn guì le.
examples.english: Starting from next month, plane tickets will become more expensive.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: 因為科技越來越進步了，所以生活也變得更便利了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi kējì yuè lái yuè jìnbù le, suǒyǐ shēnghuó yě biàn de gèng biànlì le.
examples.english: Because technology is becoming more and more advanced, life has also become more convenient.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye xiànzài měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bùdàn jīngshén hǎo le, shēntǐ yě biàn jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Grandpa now goes to bed early and gets up early every day. Not only is his spirit better, but his health has also become better.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 雲小姐最近突然開始化妝了，人也變美了。大家都猜她戀愛了。
examples.pinyin: Yún xiǎojiě zuìjìn tūrán kāishǐ huàzhuāng le, rén yě biàn měi le. Dàjiā dōu cāi tā liàn'ài le.
examples.english: Miss Yun recently suddenly started wearing makeup, and she has become prettier too. Everyone guesses that she is in love.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 開會時如果老闆突然變得很安靜，也不表達任何意見時，就表示他生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí rúguǒ lǎobǎn tūrán biàn de hěn ānjìng, yě bù biǎodá rènhé yìjiàn shí, jiù biǎoshì tā shēngqì le.
examples.english: If during a meeting the boss suddenly becomes very quiet and doesn't express any opinion, it shows that he is angry.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.
examples.english: The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 一個人的想法會隨著身分、角色的不同而改變。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén de xiǎngfǎ huì suízhe shēnfèn, juésè de bùtóng ér gǎibiàn.
examples.english: A person's way of thinking will change along with differences in identity and role.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián qī de xīnlǐ biànhuà xiāngdāng dà, xūyào fùmǔ jí lǎoshī duō guānxīn.
examples.english: During the adolescent period, psychological changes are quite large, and parents and teachers need to care more.

examples.chinese: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú qìwēn yuè lái yuè gāo, shìjiè gèdì qìhòu de biànhuà yě yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn.
examples.english: The Earth’s temperature is getting higher and higher, and climate changes around the world are also becoming more and more obvious.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 我昨天割草時沒戴帽子，整張臉都因為陽光太強而變紅了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gē cǎo shí méi dài màozi, zhěng zhāng liǎn dōu yīnwèi yángguāng tài qiáng ér biàn hóng le.
examples.english: When I mowed the lawn yesterday, I didn't wear a hat, and my whole face turned red because the sunlight was too strong.

examples.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xià xuě de shíjiān tízǎo le, qìhòu gǎibiàn huòxǔ shì zuì zhǔyào de yuányīn.
examples.english: This year the time of snowfall came earlier than planned; climate change is perhaps the main reason.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 天氣不穩定的時候，氣溫也時時跟著變化(to change,to vary)。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì bù wěndìng de shíhou, qìwēn yě shíshí gēnzhe biànhuà.
examples.english: When the weather is unstable, the temperature also constantly changes along with it.

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
examples.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
examples.english: That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

examples.chinese: 動物的體溫不見得都是不變的，像蛇的體溫就隨著環境而變。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwù de tǐwēn bù jiàndé dōu shì bùbiàn de, xiàng shé de tǐwēn jiù suízhe huánjìng ér biàn.
examples.english: Animal body temperatures are not necessarily constant; for example, a snake's body temperature changes with the environment.

examples.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
examples.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 鑽石因為無法大量出產，所以才變得珍貴。
examples.pinyin: Zuànshí yīnwèi wúfǎ dàliàng chūchǎn, suǒyǐ cái biàn de zhēnguì.
examples.english: Because diamonds cannot be produced in large quantities, they have become precious.

examples.chinese: 現代的口紅不僅使用方便，在顏色上也有不少變化。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài de kǒuhóng bùjǐn shǐyòng fāngbiàn, zài yánsè shàng yě yǒu bùshǎo biànhuà.
examples.english: Modern lipstick is not only convenient to use, but also has quite a few variations in color.

examples.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
examples.pinyin: Gùshì zhōng de nǚzhǔjiǎo wěn le báimǎ yīxià, báimǎ jiù biànchéng le yīngjùn de guówáng.
examples.english: The female protagonist in the story kissed the white horse once, and the white horse turned into a handsome king.

examples.chinese: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ hé bīng jīběnshàng shì xiāngtóng de, zhǐshì yīn wēndù ér chǎnshēng bùtóng de biànhuà.
examples.english: Water and ice are basically the same; they just undergo different changes due to temperature.

examples.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

examples.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

examples.chinese: 下星期一有課堂小考和口試，我得好好準備。
examples.pinyin: Xià xīngqīyī yǒu kètáng xiǎokǎo hé kǒushì, wǒ děi hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Next Monday there's a class quiz and an oral test; I must prepare well.

examples.chinese: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng de yuèdú bàogào xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, lián jiàoshòu dōu zài kètáng shàng dāngmiàn kuājiǎng tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang's reading report was written wonderfully; even the professor praised him to his face in class.

examples.chinese: 這所大學的外語學院有英文系、日文系、德文系和義大利文系。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué de wàiyǔ xuéyuàn yǒu Yīngwén xì, Rìwén xì, Déwén xì hé Yìdàlìwén xì.
examples.english: This university's College of Foreign Languages has an English department, a Japanese department, a German department, and an Italian department.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺的想法很傳統，除夕一定要大家回去吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye de xiǎngfǎ hěn chuántǒng, Chúxī yídìng yào dàjiā huíqù chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: My grandfather's thinking is very traditional; on New Year's Eve, he insists that everyone go back to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese: 臺灣人常用花生、紅豆做傳統點心。
examples.pinyin: Táiwānrén cháng yòng huāshēng, hóngdòu zuò chuántǒng diǎnxīn.
examples.english: Taiwanese people often use peanuts and red beans to make traditional snacks.

examples.chinese: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguórén kàn chuántǒng xìjù shí dōu xǐhuān zhǔnbèi yī pán guāzǐ, biān chī biān xīnshǎng.
examples.english: When Chinese people watch traditional opera, they all like to prepare a plate of melon seeds and enjoy them while watching.

examples.chinese: 他今天去傳統市場買菜，特別做了拿手菜招待好友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi cài, tèbié zuò le náshǒucài zhāodài hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Today he went to the traditional market to buy groceries and especially made his specialty dishes to entertain good friends.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de chuántǒng guānniàn, nǚrén wèi jià shí děi tīng fùqīn de huà, jià le rén zhīhòu jiù děi tīng zhàngfu de.
examples.english: According to traditional Chinese concepts, before a woman marries she must listen to her father's words, and after she marries she must listen to her husband's.

examples.chinese: 包著紅豆餡，裹著花生粉的麻糬，是臺灣著名的傳統甜點。
examples.pinyin: Bāo zhe hóngdòu xiàn, guǒ zhe huāshēngfěn de máshǔ, shì Táiwān zhùmíng de chuántǒng tiándiǎn.
examples.english: Mochi wrapped with red bean filling and coated with peanut powder is a famous traditional Taiwanese dessert.

examples.chinese: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guòqù dào xiànzài, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi yīzhí shì Huárén zuì zhòngshì de chuántǒng guānniàn zhī yī.
examples.english: From the past to the present, respecting elders has always been one of the traditional values that Chinese people value most.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

items.wordHook: Tangy 檸(lemon) and citrus 檬(a type of locust tree) squeezed into sweet fruit 汁(juice): 檸檬汁 means lemon juice.

examples.chinese: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.
examples.english: Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age.

items.wordHook: Combining 蠟(candle) and 燭(candle): 蠟燭 means candle.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。
examples.pinyin: Jiùzāi gōngzuò bù róngyì, yí ge rén de lìliàng shì bú gòu de, děi dàjiā yìqǐ lái.
examples.english: Disaster relief work is not easy; one person's strength is not enough—everyone needs to come together.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 我本來打算下星期騎車環島，但是颱風剛過，想來想去，還是決定不去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn xià xīngqī qíchē huándǎo, dànshì táifēng gāng guò, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bù qù le.
examples.english: I originally planned to go around the island by bike next week, but the typhoon just passed, and after thinking it over, I decided not to go after all.

examples.chinese: 公司很重視員工的身心健康，每年都安排一連五天的環島旅行，家人也可以參加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hěn zhòngshì yuángōng de shēnxīn jiànkāng, měi nián dōu ānpái yīlián wǔ tiān de huándǎo lǚxíng, jiārén yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: The company places great importance on the physical and mental health of its employees, and every year arranges a five-day island tour, which family members can also join.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
examples.pinyin: Qiúyuán de biǎoxiàn ràng jiàoliàn bùduàn yáotóu, bìng biǎoshì děi jiāqiáng píngcháng de xùnliàn.
examples.english: The players' performance made the coach constantly shake his head, and he indicated that they need to strengthen their regular training.

items.wordHook: A skilled athlete on the 球(ball) court serving as an official team 員(employee): 球員 means player.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: 他今天去傳統市場買菜，特別做了拿手菜招待好友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi cài, tèbié zuò le náshǒucài zhāodài hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Today he went to the traditional market to buy groceries and especially made his specialty dishes to entertain good friends.

examples.chinese: 我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dào Xiǎo Zhāng jiā shí, tā duān le yī pán qiē hǎo de shuǐguǒ lái zhāodài wǒmen.
examples.english: When we arrived at Little Zhang's house, he brought out a plate of cut fruit to treat us.

items.wordHook: Combining 招(summon) and 待(entertain): 招待 means treat.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi jí le, hǎoxiàng rénjiān tiāntáng yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. I've heard that one day in heaven is about several decades in the human world. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

items.wordHook: Combining 天(sky) and 堂(hall): 天堂 means heaven.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng hǎiyáng yíyàng, zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rénmen cái néng dǐdá hǎi de lìng yì biān.
examples.english: Life is like the ocean; only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

examples.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 我有手機，可是沒有電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shǒujī, kěshì méiyǒu diànnǎo.
examples.english: I have a cell phone, but I don’t have any computer.

examples.chinese: 這個新房子沒有很多家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn fángzi méiyǒu hěn duō jiājù.
examples.english: There is not much furniture in this new house.

examples.chinese: 我想去朋友家玩，可是沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù péngyǒu jiā wán, kěshì méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: I would like to go to my friend’s place, but I don’t have time.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？ 學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

examples.chinese: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我們沒有兔年，有貓年。我是貓年出生的，屬貓。
examples.pinyin: Yuènán yě yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, kěshì wǒmen méi yǒu tù nián, yǒu māo nián. Wǒ shì māo nián chūshēng de, shǔ māo.
examples.english: There are also zodiac signs in Vietnam, but we don’t have the year of the Rabbit; we have the year of the Cat. I was born in the year of the Cat, which means my zodiac animal sign is cat.

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 我想走路去一定沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒulù qù yídìng méi wèntí.
examples.english: I think it will certainly be okay going there on foot.

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Méi wèntí.
examples.english: No problem.

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 對，我應該多注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: You are right. I should pay more attention to it.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

items.wordHook: an 䧹(eagle) with a true 心(heart) stands → it knows what it 應(should) do.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

items.wordHook: Combining 密(secret) and 切(cut): 密切 means close, intimate.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 路教授最近發表的這套跟人體大腦有關的理論，令其他科學家很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zuìjìn fābiǎo de zhè tào gēn réntǐ dànǎo yǒuguān de lǐlùn, lìng qítā kēxuéjiā hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This set of theories related to the human brain recently published by Professor Lu has made other scientists very interested.

items.wordHook: Combining 理(reason) and 論(debate): 理論 means theory.

examples.chinese: 圖書館入口那裡寫著不能帶食物進去，你吃完再進去吧。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn rùkǒu nàlǐ xiězhe bù néng dài shíwù jìnqù, nǐ chī wán zài jìnqù ba.
examples.english: At the library entrance, it says you can't bring food in, so finish eating before you go in.

examples.chinese: 他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
examples.pinyin: Tā ài luàn huā qián, sān tiān xiàlái, jiù bǎ yí ge yuè de shēnghuófèi huā guāng le.
examples.english: He loves to spend money recklessly; over three days, he spent his whole month's living expenses.

examples.chinese: 冷氣機裡的網子要常拆下來洗，不然可能吹出髒空氣。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì jī lǐ de wǎngzi yào cháng chāi xiàlái xǐ, bùrán kěnéng chuī chū zāng kōngqì.
examples.english: The filter net in the air conditioner should often be taken apart and washed, otherwise it might blow out dirty air.

examples.chinese: 媽媽常一邊看做菜節目，一邊把作法抄下來。
examples.pinyin: Māma cháng yībiān kàn zuòcài jiémù, yībiān bǎ zuòfǎ chāo xiàlái.
examples.english: Mom often watches cooking shows while copying down the recipes.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 我把搭車的日期、時間都記下來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dā chē de rìqī, shíjiān dōu jì xiàlái le.
examples.english: I have written down the date and time of the train ride.

examples.chinese: 這條公路很危險，一下大雨，山上的石頭就會掉下來。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōnglù hěn wēixiǎn, yī xià dà yǔ, shān shàng de shítou jiù huì diào xiàlái.
examples.english: This road is very dangerous; whenever it rains heavily, rocks from the mountain will fall down.

examples.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
examples.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

examples.chinese: 每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì wǒ shòubuliǎo gōngzuò yālì shí, jiù huì dào húbiān sànbù, kàndào píngjìng de húshuǐ, xīnlǐ jiù huì píngjìng xiàlái.
examples.english: Every time I can't stand the work pressure, I go for a walk by the lake; seeing the tranquil lake water, my heart becomes peaceful.

examples.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

examples.chinese: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Děng yīhuìr kāihuì shí máfan nǐ fùzé dǎzì, bǎ kāihuì de nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
examples.english: When the meeting starts in a moment, please be responsible for typing and record the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 那位演員有劇場表演的經驗，所以導演決定用他。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yǎnyuán yǒu jùchǎng biǎoyǎn de jīngyàn, suǒyǐ dǎoyǎn juédìng yòng tā.
examples.english: That actor has experience in theater performances, so the director decided to use him.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友會理頭髮，為了省錢我們常常去找他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu huì lǐ tóufa, wèile shěng qián wǒmen chángcháng qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: My friend can cut hair; in order to save money, we often go to him.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

examples.chinese: 今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zìrán kēxué kèchéng suǒ jièshào de zhǔtí shì yuèqiú de gòuzào.
examples.english: The topic introduced in today's natural science course is the structure of the moon.

items.wordHook: The 土(earth) holds 厶(private) ground behind → I must 去(go).
Combining 取(take) and 代(era): 取代 means replace.
Combining 如(if) and 意(thought): 如意 means as you wish.
Combining 挫(check) and 折(break): 挫折 means frustration.
Combining 會(meet) and 議(consult): 會議 means meeting, conference.
Listen (聽) to someone speak (說) and you hear of (聽說) the thing.
When savings run thin and there is 弗(not) enough 貝(sea shell) to pay bills, daily 費(expenses) pile up.
A hunter clutching a captured 隹(bird) reaches 又(again) for another 隻(single) quarry.
